title: Around You's Circles forming lists the viewer's own city first and says which city

source.ref: Daniel's list of 30 design changes, 2026-10-19, item 4 (left over from LIVE-1017)

detail: LIVE-1017 listed the five newest circles community-wide. The card now reads the viewer's profile city, over-fetches the 30 newest discoverable circles, and shows the newest in that city first under 'Circles forming in <city>'. A viewer with no city, or a city with no new circles, still sees the community-wide newest under the plain title, so the card never claims to be local when it is not. Discovery rules are unchanged (status forming or active, unlisted false).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const p=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/nearby/page.tsx','utf8');if(!p.includes('pickCirclesForming('))bad.push('page stopped scoping Circles forming by city');if(!/\.eq\('unlisted', false\)/.test(p))bad.push('discovery filter unlisted=false is gone');if(!fs.existsSync('lib/nearby/circles-forming.ts'))bad.push('picker is missing');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1034: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the page stops picking by the viewer's city or loses the unlisted filter. Behavior is lib/nearby/circles-forming.test.ts.
